hook.en: When an auto starts from a signal, its velocity changes every second. The rate of that change is *acceleration*.
hook.kn: ಸಿಗ್ನಲ್‌ನಿಂದ ಆಟೋ ಹೊರಡುವಾಗ ಅದರ ವೇಗ ಪ್ರತಿ ಸೆಕೆಂಡಿಗೂ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಆ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯ ದರವೇ ವೇಗೋತ್ಕರ್ಷ.

body.en: *Acceleration* is the rate of change of velocity, $a = dv/dt$, measured in m/s². It is the slope of the v–t graph. If a and v have opposite signs the body slows down (retardation).
body.kn: ವೇಗೋತ್ಕರ್ಷ ಎಂದರೆ ವೇಗದ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯ ದರ, a = dv/dt. ಇದು v–t ನಕ್ಷೆಯ ಇಳಿಜಾರು.

say.en: Slope of v-t graph equals acceleration.
Area under v-t graph equals displacement.

title.en: Reading acceleration from a v–t graph

say.en: A body's velocity rises from 2 metres per second steadily. We plot velocity against time.
The slope of the v–t graph is the acceleration: change in velocity over change in time.
The area under the v–t graph is the displacement. Here it is a trapezium: 39 metres in six seconds.
When acceleration points opposite to velocity, the body slows down. This is retardation.

text.en: a opposite to v: speed falls

narration.en: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity, the slope of the v–t graph. When v and a have the same sign the car speeds up; opposite signs and it slows down, even if a is positive. The shaded area under the v–t graph is the displacement.
narration.kn: ವೇಗೋತ್ಕರ್ಷ = ವೇಗದ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯ ದರ, v–t ನಕ್ಷೆಯ ಇಳಿಜಾರು. v ಮತ್ತು a ಒಂದೇ ಚಿಹ್ನೆಯಾದರೆ ಕಾರು ವೇಗ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ; ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಚಿಹ್ನೆಯಾದರೆ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, a ಧನಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿದ್ದರೂ ಸಹ. v–t ನಕ್ಷೆಯ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಛಾಯೆ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ ಸ್ಥಾನಪಲ್ಲಟ.

problem.en: v = 4 + 3t (m/s). Find the acceleration and the velocity at t = 2 s.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. v = 4 + 3t (m/s). Find the acceleration and the velocity at t = 2 s.

say.en: Let us solve this together. v equals 4 plus 3t metres per second. Find the acceleration and the velocity at t equals 2 seconds.
a equals dv over dt equals 3 metres per second squared.
v2 equals 4 plus 6 equals 10 metres per second.
So the answer is 3 metres per second squared; 10 metres per second.
